newsitem.title: USA: Sri Lanka seeks 50-60,000 T U.S. wheat for Jun/Jly.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka seeks 50-60,000 T U.S. wheat for Jun/Jly.

text.p: Sri Lanka is tendering for 50,000 to 60,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for shipment between June 30 and July 19, 1997, under Title I of the PL-480 program, the Sri Lanka embassy said on Thursday.

Sri Lanka seeks U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat or northern or dark northern spring wheat, with offers due by June 5. Purchase cost must not exceed $10 million under the PL-480 authorization, the embassy said.
Sri Lanka seeks minimum 12 percent protein and moisture content wheats, with moisture not to exceed 13.5 pct.
Offers are due by 1530 EDT/1930 GMT on June 5 at the Sri Lanka embassy in Washington and must remain valid until 1000/1400 on June 6, it said.
